text: Wong Jawa ngarani 21 “selikur” lan 22 “rolikur”. Yèn ngono, “sangalikur” iku angka pira?
gloss: Javanese call 21 “selikur” and 22 “rolikur”. So what number is “sangalikur”? — 29: -likur marks the twenties, sanga is nine.

text: Kanca kandha omahé “uadoh”. Tegesé omah iku kepriyé?
gloss: A friend says his house is “uadoh”. What does that mean? — Very far: Javanese intensifies an adjective by stretching its vowel to u (adoh → uadoh, cilik → cuilik).

text: Saka “sapu” dadi “nyapu”, saka “tulis” dadi apa?
gloss: “Sapu” (broom) becomes “nyapu” (to sweep); what does “tulis” become? — “Nulis”: the active nasal prefix turns initial t into n, as s into ny.

text: Terusna paribasan iki: “Becik ketitik, ala …”
gloss: Complete the saying “Good will be noticed, evil …” — “ketara” (will show): «Becik ketitik, ala ketara».

text: Ing petungan pasaran Jawa, yèn wingi Wagé, sésuk pasarané apa?
gloss: In the Javanese five-day market week, if yesterday was Wagé, what is tomorrow? — Legi: the cycle runs Legi, Paing, Pon, Wagé, Kliwon, so today is Kliwon and the week wraps round to Legi.

text: Miturut legendha, Bandung Bondowoso kudu gawé sewu candhi sewengi kanggo nglamar sapa?
gloss: In the legend, Bandung Bondowoso had to build a thousand temples in one night to win whom? — Rara Jonggrang, the Prambanan legend.

text: Piranti cilik kanggo nulisaké malam panas ing kain batik tulis diarani apa?
gloss: The small tool that draws hot wax onto hand-drawn batik is called? — Canting (gawangan is the frame, wajan the wax pot, cap the stamp of printed batik).

text: Ing angkringan, sega sakepel sing dibungkus karo sambel lan iwak teri diarani sega apa?
gloss: At an angkringan stall, the fistful of rice wrapped with chili paste and anchovies is called? — Sega kucing (“cat rice”), named for its tiny portion.

text: Instrumen gamelan sing paling gedhé, digantung lan ditabuh ing pungkasané gendhing iku apa?
gloss: The largest gamelan instrument, hung and struck at the end of a piece, is? — The gong (gong ageng), which closes each cycle.

text: Ing wayang, sapa bapaké punakawan Gareng, Petruk lan Bagong?
gloss: In wayang, who is the father of the clown-servants Gareng, Petruk and Bagong? — Semar (Togog and Bilung serve the other side).

text: Ing dongèng, Kancil seneng nyolong timun ing kebon duwèké sapa?
gloss: In the fable, whose garden does the mouse-deer Kancil steal cucumbers from? — Pak Tani, the farmer.

text: Nyabrang saka Banyuwangi menyang Bali, jam kudu dimajokaké sejam. Bali nganggo zona wektu apa?
gloss: Crossing from Banyuwangi to Bali you set the clock an hour forward. Which time zone does Bali use? — WITA (Central Indonesian Time, UTC+8); Java is on WIB.

text: Ing bulu tangkis, pukulan banter sing mudhun landhep saka dhuwur sirah diarani apa?
gloss: In badminton, what is the hard, steeply downward overhead shot called? — The smash.

text: Ing WhatsApp, centhang loro sing werna biru tegesé apa?
gloss: On WhatsApp, what do two blue ticks mean? — The message has been read (two grey ticks: delivered).

text: Botol kaca kebak banyu ditinggal sewengi ing freezer, ésuké pecah. Apa sebabé?
gloss: A full glass bottle of water left overnight in the freezer cracks. Why? — Water expands as it freezes.

text: Ing film animasi “Frozen”, sapa jenengé ratu sing bisa nggawé ès lan salju?
gloss: In the animated film “Frozen”, what is the name of the queen who makes ice and snow? — Elsa (Anna is her sister).

text: Ing label klambi, ukuran “XL” iku cekakan saka apa?
gloss: On a clothing label, what does the size “XL” stand for? — Extra Large.

text: Wasabi, bumbu ijo sing pedhesé nyegrak menyang irung, lumrahé dipangan karo apa?
gloss: Wasabi, the green condiment whose heat shoots up the nose, is usually eaten with? — Sushi.

text: Kéwan cilik ing témbok omah sing bisa ngeculaké buntuté yèn dicekel iku apa?
gloss: Which small creature on the house wall can drop its tail when caught? — The house gecko (cecak).

text: Woh apa sing ambuné banter nganti akèh hotel lan maskapai nglarang digawa mlebu?
gloss: Which fruit smells so strong that many hotels and airlines ban it? — Durian.

text: Pokémon kuning sing bisa ngetokaké setrum lan dadi maskot Pokémon jenengé sapa?
gloss: The yellow electric Pokémon that is the franchise's mascot is called? — Pikachu.

text: Klambi regané Rp80.000 olèh diskon 25%. Kudu mbayar pira?
gloss: A shirt costs Rp80,000 with a 25% discount. How much do you pay? — Rp60,000: a quarter of 80,000 is 20,000.

text: Sunscreen dianggo kanggo nglindhungi kulit saka sinar srengéngé jinis apa?
gloss: Sunscreen protects the skin from which kind of sunlight? — Ultraviolet.

text: Seni nglempit kertas saka Jepang dadi manuk utawa kodhok diarani apa?
gloss: The Japanese art of folding paper into birds or frogs is called? — Origami (kirigami also cuts the paper; ikebana is flower arranging).

text: Amplop abang isi dhuwit sing diwènèhaké nalika Imlèk diarani apa?
gloss: The red envelope with money given at Chinese New Year is called? — Angpao.

text: Alamat situs web sing pungkasané “.jp” asalé saka negara endi?
gloss: A website address ending in “.jp” is from which country? — Japan (Jordan is .jo, Jamaica .jm, Germany .de).

text: Gelas ès teh ing dhuwur méja suwé-suwé teles ing sisih njaba. Banyu iku asalé saka ngendi?
gloss: A glass of iced tea on the table gets wet on the outside. Where does that water come from? — Water vapour in the air condenses on the cold glass.

text: Saliyané lenga lan cuka, bahan utama mayonès iku apa?
gloss: Besides oil and vinegar, what is the main ingredient of mayonnaise? — Egg yolk, which emulsifies the oil.

text: Ing kirab malem 1 Sura Kraton Surakarta, kéwan apa sing mlaku ing ngarep dhéwé?
gloss: In the Surakarta palace procession on the night of 1 Sura, which animals lead the way? — The albino buffaloes (kebo bulé) of the Kyai Slamet line.

text: Wong Tengger nganakaké upacara Kasada kanthi nglarung sesaji menyang kawah gunung endi?
gloss: The Tengger people hold the Kasada ceremony by throwing offerings into the crater of which mountain? — Bromo.

text: Riyaya seminggu sakwisé Lebaran ing Jawa diarani Bakda apa?
gloss: The feast a week after Eid in Java is called Bakda what? — Bakda Kupat, the rice-dumpling feast.

text: Bakul tuku sarung telung kodhi. Gunggungé sarung pira?
gloss: A trader buys three kodhi of sarongs. How many sarongs in all? — 60: a kodhi is 20 pieces (36 would be three dozen).

text: Kakangé bapak diundang Pakdhe. Adhiné bapak sing lanang diundang apa?
gloss: Father's elder brother is called Pakdhe. What do you call father's younger brother? — Paklik: -dhe is from gedhe (big), -lik from cilik (small).

text: Didi Kempot, “The Godfather of Broken Heart”, misuwur lumantar lagu-lagu Jawa aliran apa?
gloss: Didi Kempot, “The Godfather of Broken Heart”, became famous for Javanese songs in which genre? — Campursari.

text: Yèn HP disetel “mode pesawat”, apa sing utamané dipatèni?
gloss: When a phone is set to airplane mode, what is mainly switched off? — Its wireless signals (mobile network, and by default Wi-Fi and Bluetooth).

text: Golongan getih endi sing diarani “donor universal”?
gloss: Which blood group is called the “universal donor”? — O (AB is the universal recipient).

text: Negara Éropah endi sing ora nduwé segara babar pisan?
gloss: Which European country has no coast at all? — Switzerland.

text: Iwak salmon nglangi adoh menyang ngendi nalika arep ngendhog?
gloss: Where do salmon swim far to lay their eggs? — Upstream in rivers, where they hatched.

text: Ing basket, tembakan sing mlebu saka njaba garis lengkung olèh poin pira?
gloss: In basketball, how many points for a basket made from beyond the arc? — 3.

text: Kutha kuna Machu Picchu ing pegunungan Andes dibangun déning bangsa apa?
gloss: The ancient Andean city of Machu Picchu was built by which people? — The Inca.

text: Ing film “Toy Story”, sapa jenengé boneka koboi kancané Buzz Lightyear?
gloss: In “Toy Story”, what is the name of the cowboy doll who is Buzz Lightyear's friend? — Woody.

text: Bocah lanang sing ora gelem gedhé lan manggon ing Neverland iku sapa?
gloss: The boy who won't grow up and lives in Neverland is? — Peter Pan.

text: Pola ing wilahan keris sing tuwuh saka campuran wesi lan logam liya diarani apa?
gloss: The pattern on a keris blade that comes from forging iron with another metal is called? — Pamor (dhapur is the blade's shape, warangka the sheath, ukiran the hilt).

text: Tembang macapat endi sing jenengé ateges “metu” lan nggambaraké bayi lair?
gloss: Which macapat verse form has a name meaning “to come out” and stands for birth? — Mijil (mijil = to emerge); Megatruh and Pocung stand for death.

text: Miturut bobot, unsur kimia apa sing paling akèh ing awak manungsa?
gloss: By mass, which chemical element is most abundant in the human body? — Oxygen, about 65% (hydrogen leads only by number of atoms).

text: Gunung endi sing pucuké paling dhuwur ing pulo Jawa?
gloss: Which mountain has the highest summit on Java? — Semeru (3,676 m); Slamet is second.

text: Candhi Borobudur dibangun ing jaman wangsa apa?
gloss: Borobudur was built in the time of which dynasty? — The Shailendra dynasty, in the 8th–9th centuries.

text: Logam apa sing paling entheng, sing saiki dadi bahan utama baterai hapé?
gloss: Which metal is the lightest of all and now the key material of phone batteries? — Lithium (lithium-ion batteries).

text: Taun 1633 Sultan Agung nggabungaké kalender Saka karo kalender apa dadi kalender Jawa?
gloss: In 1633 Sultan Agung merged the Saka calendar with which calendar to create the Javanese calendar? — The Hijri (Islamic lunar) calendar, keeping the Saka year count.

text: Fosil Pithecanthropus erectus ing Trinil, Ngawi, ditemokaké taun 1891 déning sapa?
gloss: Who found the Pithecanthropus erectus fossil at Trinil, Ngawi, in 1891? — Eugène Dubois (von Koenigswald later dug at Sangiran).
